newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 16.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 16. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

More bodies have been found in a scenic lake in Indonesia's North Sumatra province where an overloaded ferry sank on Sunday night, pushing the death toll to 78, while 22 more passangers were reported still missing.
Cement giant PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa proposed a spinoff and sale of its 50.1 percent shareholding, worth five trillion rupiah, in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur .
The armed forces officers and their families are banned from conducting business, Defence Minister Edi Sudradjat told members of parliament.

Indonesia was willing to modify its controversial national car policy should it lose at the World Trade Organisation (WTO) panel on the car dispute, Industry and Trade Minister Tungky Ariwibowo said. He added that the modification would not hurt Indonesia because by the time the panel reached a decision the country would have the needed capability to produce the national car.
